### 🔎 Search Terms

generic parameter extends generic type parameter based on generic parameter

### 🕗 Version & Regression Information

3.3.333 to 5.7.2 (ie the versions supported by Typescript Playground)

### ⏯ Playground Link

https://www.typescriptlang.org/play/?#

### 💻 Code

```typescript
class TestClass<TData> {}

const test1: TestClass<{ value1: string }> = new TestClass<{ value1: string }>();

function testFunc<T extends TestClass<TData>, TData>(value: T, data: TData) {

}

testFunc(test1, { value2: 14 }); // I would expect this to fail.
testFunc<TestClass<{ value1: string }>, { value2: number }>(test1, { value2: 14 }); // I would expect this to definitely fail as surely TData should be the same for both?
```


### 🙁 Actual behavior

No errors are highlighted for the two calls to `testFunc()`.

### 🙂 Expected behavior

Both calls to `testFunc()` should be highlighted as errors.
The first call should fail because `{ value2: number}` is not the `TData` type used for the `TestClass<TData>` instance assigned to `test1`.
The second call should fail highlighting the generic parameter type inconsistency for `TData`.

### Additional information about the issue

I am attempting to create a generic method with two generic type parameters and two parameters using those generic types, where the generic type of the second is tied to the generic type of the first:

```typescript
class TestClass<TData> {}

function testFunc<T extends TestClass<TData>, TData>(value: T, data: TData) {
}
```

However, when attempting to use it there does not seem to be any consistency enforced between the TData parameters:

```typescript
const test1: TestClass<{ value1: string }> = new TestClass<{ value2: string }>();

testFunc(test1, { value1: 14 }); // I would expect this to fail.
testFunc<TestClass<{ value1: string }>, { value2: number }>(test1, { value2: 14 }); // I would expect this to definitely fail as surely TData should be enforced as the same for both?
```

Explicitly specifying the types incorrectly as shown in the second call to `testFunc()` above does not result in any apparent errors either.

I am unsure if the behaviour I am seeing is a bug or if this is something I am doing incorrectly.
items.title: Consistency between generic type parameter of extends generic type based on another generic type parameter is not enforced
